# KSV Academy

> Premier coaching institute in Ulwe, Navi Mumbai for Classes 5th to 12th (CBSE, ICSE, Maharashtra State Board), IIT-JEE (Main & Advanced), NEET-UG, MH-CET, and Degree Programs (B.Com, BMS, BCA). Founded and led by Mr. Salam Khan with 10+ years academic legacy.

## Overview
KSV Academy (Where Learning Meets Excellence) is Ulwe Sector 19's leading academic coaching center. It provides concept-first coaching, disciplined small batches (capped at 25 students), daily one-on-one doubt clearing, biometric attendance alerts, and merit scholarships up to 60%.

- **Location**: MGM Residency, Shop No.02, Plot No.161, opp. Om Sai Hospital, Sector 19, Ulwe, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 410206, India
- **Coordinates**: 18.9734° N, 73.0232° E
- **Director**: Mr. Salam Khan (M.Sc, B.Ed — 10+ Years Experience in Physics & Mathematics)
- **Primary Helpline**: +91 79059 00350
- **Secondary Helpline**: +91 99840 58406
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/917905900350
- **Email**: KSVAcademy2024@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://ksvacademy.org
- **Current Academic Session**: 2026–2027
- **Free Trial**: 3-Days Free Demo Class with zero upfront fees or credit card requirements

## Key Academic Offerings

### School Section (Classes 5th to 10th)
- [Secondary Foundation & Board Mastery](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): Comprehensive coaching for CBSE, ICSE, and Maharashtra State Board (SSC).
- **Subjects**: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, English, Social Studies (SST).
- **Features**: Visual conceptual proofs, weekly chapter-wise tests, personal doubt solving, exam strategy workshops.

### Competitive Entrances (Engineering & Medical)
- [IIT-JEE Main & Advanced Integrated Program](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): Concept-building and high-yield problem solving led by Mr. Salam Khan & senior faculty.
- [NEET-UG Medical Entrance Batch](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): NCERT line-by-line mastery, high-yield biology diagram analysis, and rapid chemistry calculation techniques.
- [MH-CET (Engineering & Pharmacy)](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): Maharashtra State CET preparation seamlessly integrated with 11th & 12th HSC syllabus.

### Junior College (11th & 12th)
- [11th & 12th Science Stream](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): In-depth PCM / PCB coaching targeting 90%+ in board exams while building competitive entrance foundation.
- [11th & 12th Commerce Stream](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): Bookkeeping & Accountancy, Economics, Secretarial Practice (SP), Organization of Commerce and Management (OCM), and Mathematics.

### Undergraduate & Degree College
- [Commerce & Management Degrees](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): University syllabus coaching for B.Com (Financial Accounting, Taxation, Costing), BMS (Management Studies), BAF, BBA, and BCA (Computer Applications & Programming).

### Postgraduate Programs
- [Master of Commerce & Management (M.Com)](https://ksvacademy.org/courses): Advanced financial management, business analytics, and project viva preparation.

## Distinguished Faculty Leadership
- **Mr. Salam Khan** (Founder & Director): M.Sc, B.Ed. 10+ years dedicated mentoring in Physics and Mathematics for NEET, IIT-JEE, and State Boards.
- **Mr. Rameshwar Mishra** (Senior Faculty - Chemistry): M.Sc, M.Ed. 15+ years experience in Organic, Inorganic, and Physical Chemistry.
- **Mr. Aman Kumar Soni** (Faculty - Chemistry & Mathematics): B.Tech. Engineering pedagogical approach with analytical problem-solving rigor.
- **Mrs. Hafiza Palikar** (Faculty - Mathematics): M.Sc (Mathematics) from Mumbai University. Pure & Applied Mathematics specialist.
- **Mr. Rafeek Khan** (Faculty - Computer Science & Math): M.Sc (Computer Science). BCA programming, discrete maths, and computer applications mentor.
- **Mrs. Lubna Khan** (Faculty - English & SST): BMS (Bachelor of Management Studies). Language, literature, comprehension, and humanities educator.

## Admissions & Scholarships (2026–2027)
- **3-Days Free Demo Trial**: Students can attend 3 actual classroom lectures before paying fees. Register at https://ksvacademy.org/#demoModal or via WhatsApp (+91 79059 00350).
- **Merit Scholarship Up to 60%**: Awarded based on performance in the KSV Diagnostic cum Scholarship Test or previous academic board results (85%+ earns direct concessions).
- **Fee Installments**: Interest-free monthly and quarterly payment options.

## Class Timings & Batch Structure
- **Batch Size**: Maximum 25 students per batch ensuring individual mentoring.
- **Morning Shift**: 8:00 AM – 11:30 AM
- **Evening Shift**: 4:00 PM – 8:30 PM
- **Weekend Shift**: Dedicated doubt-clearing sessions and mock CBT test series.
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday: 7:30 AM – 9:30 PM | Sunday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM.
